description: This file contains C source code for processing and parsing WDMP (wisdom device management protocol) related requests and forming responses. It includes functions for parsing get/set/store requests, forming responses, and mapping status codes to messages, indicating it is core logic for handling protocol requests in a device management system.

methods.name: void parse_get_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for a GET operation and populates a request structure based on parameters such as OIDs or names, attributes, and request type.

methods.name: void parse_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for a SET operation, extracting parameters including OIDs or parameter names, values, and data types, and populates the request structure.

methods.name: void parse_set_attr_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for setting attributes, particularly notifications, and updates the request structure accordingly.

methods.name: void parse_test_and_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request for test-and-set operation, extracting CID, CMC, and parameters, and populates the request structure.

methods.name: void parse_replace_rows_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to replace multiple rows in a table, extracting row data and populating the request structure.

methods.name: void parse_add_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to add a single row to a table, extracting row parameters and populating the request structure.

methods.name: void parse_delete_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to delete a specific row in a table based on row identifier.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a get request, including parameters, data types, and status message based on the response structure.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_attr_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a get attribute request, including attribute details such as notify and status messages.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a set request, including status message and potentially parameter results.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_table_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for table operations, including new row object and status message.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_test_and_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for test-and-set operation, including parameters for CMC and CID and status message.

methods.name: void mapWdmpStatusToStatusMessage(WDMP_STATUS status,char * result)
methods.description: Maps WDMP status codes to human-readable status messages.

methods.name: void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE * statusCode,int paramCount,WDMP_STATUS * ret)
methods.description: Determines overall response status code based on individual parameter return statuses.

ctags.name: getStatusCode
ctags.pattern: /^ void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE *statusCode, int paramCount, WDMP_STATUS * ret)$/
